description: Deterministic single-shot call to one MCP tool — no LLM in the loop. Args templating supports {partition_key}, {partition_keys.<dim>}, {run_id}.

outputs.description: Parsed tool response (dict/list if JSON, else string).

backfill_policy.label: Backfill Policy
backfill_policy.description: Backfill execution strategy for a partitioned asset. 'single_run' materializes an entire backfill range in one run (one tool call per partition in the range, each with its own {partition_key} substitution; the asset value is a dict {partition_key: result}). 'multi_run' launches one run per partition (optionally capped via Backfill Max Partitions Per Run). Leave empty for Dagster's default. Ignored when no partitioning is configured. 'single_run' requires a partition-range-aware IO manager -- a generic filesystem/default IO manager cannot persist a single_run output spanning multiple partitions and will raise a clear error at materialization time.

backfill_policy_max_partitions_per_run.label: Backfill Max Partitions Per Run
backfill_policy_max_partitions_per_run.description: For Backfill Policy = 'multi_run' only: maximum partitions materialized per run. Leave empty for Dagster's default (1).

asset_tags.description: Additional key-value tags applied to the asset in the Dagster catalog.
asset_tags.label: Tags

partition_type.description: Partition type: 'daily', 'weekly', 'monthly', 'hourly', 'static', 'multi', 'dynamic', or None for unpartitioned.
partition_type.label: Partition Type

partition_start.description: Partition start date in ISO format, e.g. '2024-01-01'. Required for time-based partition types.
partition_start.label: Partition Start (ISO)

partition_cron_schedule.description: Required when partition_type='cron'. A cron expression restricting the date axis to a custom cadence, e.g. '0 0 * * 1-5' for weekdays only (business-day cadence). Built on Dagster's TimeWindowPartitionsDefinition(cron_schedule=...).
partition_cron_schedule.label: Partition Cron Schedule

partition_cron_fmt.description: strftime format for partition keys produced by partition_type='cron'. Only change this for a sub-daily cron_schedule.
partition_cron_fmt.label: Partition Cron Fmt

partition_values.description: Comma-separated values for static or multi partitioning, e.g. 'customer_a,customer_b,customer_c'.
partition_values.label: Partition Values (CSV)

partition_dimensions.description: Multi-axis partition spec: list of {name, type, start, values, dynamic_partition_name} dicts. Overrides flat fields when set.
partition_dimensions.label: Partition Dimensions (multi-axis)

freshness_max_lag_minutes.description: Maximum acceptable lag in minutes before the asset is considered stale. Defines a FreshnessPolicy.
freshness_max_lag_minutes.label: Freshness Max Lag (min)

freshness_cron.description: Cron schedule string for the freshness policy, e.g. '0 9 * * 1-5' (weekdays at 9am).
freshness_cron.label: Freshness Cron

retry_policy_max_retries.description: Max retries on asset failure. Defines a RetryPolicy.
retry_policy_max_retries.label: Retry Max

retry_policy_backoff.label: Retry Backoff
retry_policy_backoff.description: Retry backoff strategy: exponential (doubles the delay each time), linear (adds a fixed delay each time), or fixed (constant delay).

deps.description: Lineage-only upstream asset keys (no data passed at runtime).
deps.label: Lineage-Only Deps
